visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses and short black hair, wearing a black Nike zip-up jacket, stands in a kitchen holding a wooden cutting board with a cooked steak. (2) Hands use a clear salt grinder to season a thick, raw ribeye steak. (3) The raw steak is placed into a hot black pan; steam rises immediately as the meat is seared. (4) Metal tongs are used to flip the steak and sear its thick edges against the pan's side. (5) The steak is removed and rests on a plate, showing a browned crust. (6) Butter and whole garlic cloves are added to the pan, melting into a frothy mixture. (7) A spoon repeatedly bastes the steak with the hot melted butter while it continues to cook. (8) The steak is placed back on the cutting board and sliced with a knife, revealing a pink, medium-rare center. (9) The man is shown in a close-up, eating a slice of the steak with a fork, closing his eyes and nodding in satisfaction. (10) The man holds the board of sliced steak and garlic, pointing at the food while addressing the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天來挑戰. [Variety]: 乾式熟成肋眼牛排. (2) [Subtitle]: 退冰到常溫 加上海鹽吸乾水分. (3) [Subtitle]: 大火熱鍋. (4) [Subtitle]: 沙拉油冒煙後下鍋. (5) [Subtitle]: 每一面約10秒翻面. (6) [Subtitle]: 側面也要煎到. (7) [Subtitle]: 維持大火煎3分鐘. (8) [Subtitle]: 焦黃色起鍋. (9) [Subtitle]: 起鍋靜置7分鐘. (10) [Subtitle]: 廢油倒掉 加入奶油, 大蒜. (11) [Subtitle]: 使用中小火. (12) [Subtitle]: 長湯匙淋上熱奶油. (13) [Subtitle]: 中小火 煎7分鐘起鍋. (14) [Subtitle]: 外皮焦香 內部粉紅的五分熟. (15) [Subtitle]: 搭配海鹽 蒜片 大蒜. (16) [Subtitle]: 這樣極致的 乾式熟成肋眼牛排 你喜歡嗎?

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A calm male voice introduces the challenge. Background music consists of a bright, steady acoustic guitar strumming at a moderate tempo. (2) A sharp, percussive grinding sound is heard as salt is added to the meat, cutting through the music momentarily. (3) Intense, broadband sizzling noise begins as the steak is seared, indicating high heat. The BGM continues smoothly underneath. (4) Short, metallic clinking sounds occur from the use of tongs against the pan. (5) Bubbling and soft liquid splashing sounds are heard as butter and garlic are added and basted over the meat. (6) A crisp scraping and slicing sound accompanies the knife cutting through the steak crust on the wood board. (7) Rhythmic chewing sounds and a soft vocal exhale suggest satisfaction from eating. (8) The male voice returns with a friendly tone to conclude the video, with the guitar BGM fading out gently.
